game.core.world.fact.summary: Settlements near forests, mountains, or other monster-haunted reaches share responsibility for local safety. Patrols, watch posts, warning bells, and trained monster-hunters form a practical safety net, while communities try to preserve ordinary life instead of becoming permanent military camps.
